picks.editorial_note: A $100M NSF program to build regional AI compute hubs nationwide is one of the largest single infrastructure investments this week, aimed at democratizing access to AI compute for scientific research and workforce training.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: NIST's formal MOU with the DOE Office of Science to join the White House-led Genesis Mission signals a coordinated federal policy push to embed AI across the national science and technology enterprise.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope marks a genuine technical first in autonomous scientific observation, showcasing how AI can independently direct experimental instruments.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's $24.9M NSF-funded national self-driving laboratory for metals will give researchers nationwide shared access to robotics-and-AI-accelerated alloy discovery, a major boost for materials science infrastructure.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis researchers were among the first cohort selected for DOE's Genesis Mission, a flagship national program applying AI to accelerate discovery across energy and science — reflecting broad federal-academic alignment on AI-driven research.
picks.title: UC Davis Researchers Selected for Landmark DOE Genesis Mission Awards

picks.editorial_note: Virginia Tech's $20M NSF grant for a cloud-based, AI-enabled semiconductor lab strengthens the national network of automated labs supporting the Genesis Mission's push for AI-accelerated chip research.
picks.title: University receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: RPI's selection for two DOE Genesis Mission Phase I projects, including AI-guided rare-earth materials discovery, illustrates deepening university-national lab collaboration under the federal AI science initiative.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5M NSF AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation, spanning Delaware, Delaware State, Princeton, Penn, and Florida, targets real-world impact in rehabilitation and health care through cross-institutional AI research.
picks.title: UF researchers join new NSF-funded AI institute to transform rehabilitation and health care

picks.editorial_note: HKU engineers' atomically thin analogue in-memory search chip offers a novel hardware approach to bypass the von Neumann bottleneck, a meaningful advance for energy-efficient AI computing.
picks.title: HKU Engineering develops atomically thin “analogue in-memory search” chip to redefine AI computing limits with minimalist architecture - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: Lawrence Berkeley National Lab's AI framework combining thermodynamics and machine learning to predict solid-state reaction pathways could meaningfully speed up materials synthesis discovery.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials
